method: Identical Chromium154/Linux/2 CPU quota/8GiB paired React19 development builds, actual useGame/Runtime/native IDB. DOM click (not physical input), fresh browser/Worker per batch, first AI work cold. Before c370ff8; after foreground 8a8737c; offline source is recorded per dataset (later explicit service-budget passthrough, foreground path unchanged). n=20 batches for count1, n=5 for count5/20/50, each of six foreground scenarios plus an actual away/resume offline case. Quantiles nearest-rank; pooled rows are correlated FIFO observations, not independent single-command SLA. phase percentile summaries are distributions of per-batch percentiles, not pooled raw AI events. Validation instrumentation both versions. No Android.
